idea-plugin.name: Bitbucket Companion
idea-plugin.description: A GUI for the Bitbucket Cloud workflow this team already scripted in bb.py: browse and clone repos, see git status and pull/branch/commit/push per repo, create and watch pull requests, and browse pipelines with a live-updating step list and log viewer - all backed by an Atlassian API token stored in the IDE's secure credential store.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.4

  • New PR detail view: description, changed files, native side-by-side diff viewer, view/post comments
  • PR dialog: source/destination branch dropdowns loaded from the remote, bigger window
  • Blocked editing merged/declined pull requests
  • Pipeline log: line-wrap toggle; Watch Steps now follows the running step and tails its log
  • Toolbars wrap instead of clipping when the tool window is narrow
  • Repos tab: slug include/exclude keyword filters with an active-filters summary
  • Local/Git Status: Branch column and column header tooltips

0.1.3

  • git fetch/pull/push now authenticate using the token from Settings, instead of requiring a system BB_TOKEN environment variable
  • Pull Requests/Pipelines: Repo field is now a dropdown populated from the workspace's repo list

0.1.2

  • Fixed a plugin.xml typo that silently prevented the tool window, settings page, and notifications from ever registering
  • Tool window moved to the left stripe

0.1.1

  • Replaced the borrowed GitHub icon with a Bitbucket-blue tool window icon
